restrictions: The two messages have 1024t + 55 and 1024t + 63 bytes for one t with 1 <= t < 2^32: t zero chunks of 1024 bytes followed by a last chunk of one block, compressed as a non-root chunk with counter t (v12 = t, v13 = 0), flags 3 and its true block length; the 63-byte block ends in eight zero bytes. Equal last-chunk chaining values give equal digests by the tree lemma of proof.md Section 7. The counter t is solved per trial as ROL(K0.d1,16) XOR K0.a1 (Section 8); a trial with t = 0 is invalid and never counted.
Unkeyed BLAKE3-256 with 2 prefix rounds, standard IV, permutation and feed-forward, full 256-bit digest; an ordinary collision between two distinct complete messages.

A distinct path, recorded at its own price: the counter construction of proof.md Section 8 with its free words drawn on GPT Sol's special-frame chart (D1.d1 = 0, b = q - W13 with q in {0, 80000000}, Y4 in the class of eta) by an exact 64-seed frame inverse and an exact uniform frame sampler (A4-A6); each admitted frame serves m = 11 one-candidate queries on a canonical catalog of 13 * 2^27 records for the six E1 outcomes S = {175,185,275,285,385,685}020a0 of beta* = 18b0e098, with the T31 orientation, each certifying at most one complete pair by Lemma V (A7, A8). Exact: the frame equation and inverse, the sampler law, the query yield identity, the per-query cap sigma13/104, the local certification, the cluster retention bound and the charges. Heuristic: the special-chart full-hit mean (H1-special-full-mean) and the mean frame multiplicity (H2-frame-balance), under which success is above 0.39.

Classical 256-bit word RAM under collision-frontier-v5, 430 machine units per target compression. Charged at budgets, not means (proof.md A9, A10): Bsam = 520,495,935,719,214,164,906,612 sampler batches of four proposals at <= 512 units; N = 260,247,967,857,566,502,269,693 admitted bases at 1024 units, each with 11 queries at <= 3168 units (failures and full certification included); catalog 2^46, layout 2^34, metadata 2^16 + 8192, the selection procedure SEL of A10 at its cap S_old = 8,882,224,365,081,579,520; final messages 2^38 compressions. The algorithm halts with failure when Bsam batches are spent or N bases have run. Total below 2^84.20721704; 84.2073 is rounded up at the fourth decimal and checked as an integer inequality (A10). The unit allowances are operation bounds proved block by block in proof.md A6 and A7, not counts of an implementation.

The submitted program and both experiments are those of our whole-class chunk-counter package, unchanged. They run the root instance (counter 0, flags 11) of the shared construction (proof.md Sections 4 to 6) and do not implement or run this path: no frame inverse, sampler, catalog or query of Part A is in the program. No digest experiment can show a half-collision of a non-root chunk's chaining value. No full 2-round collision is exhibited. The organizer-run experiments measure neither H1 nor H2; the participant measurements of proof.md A12 are untrusted and concern a partial pass event and the frame multiplicity, not the full hit.

memory_log2_bytes 44: four streamed bases, the catalog (13 * 2^32 bytes) and scratch fit 2^38 bytes; every run of SEL halts at 2^34 bytes and SEL keeps below 2^20 bytes of its own; the two output messages take below 2^43 bytes; held at once, below 2^43 + 2^38 + 2^35 < 2^44 (proof.md A10). preprocessing_log2 55, included in time_log2, bounds the once-only work: the selection procedure SEL of proof.md A10, which found the advice (116 solver runs capped at 2^56 operations each, one count per model capped at 2^52 + 2^10, the choice of S capped at 2^50: S_old = 8,882,224,365,081,579,520 machine units, below 2^54.198 target compressions; a bound by construction, since every run halts at its cap; not a premise), plus catalog 2^46, layout 2^34 and metadata, in all below 2^54.1975. Advice: the 76-byte record ADV of proof.md A3 (the six constants, eta, beta*, the cube mask and value, the six taus, eps and the two q values, which no search selects); the analysis uses only properties of ADV itself (Lemma UA).

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. Let V be uniform on the A admitted special-frame bases of proof.md A5 (flags 3, b = q - W13 with q in {0, 80000000}, Y4 in the class of eta), and let mu_raw = E_V[G(V) / 2^85], where G(V) counts the words j, g and the members c of Q* for which the physical context is a full valid hit of A3 (t != 0, c in Q*, an E1 outcome in S, all eight last-chunk chaining-value words equal). Premise: mu_raw >= mu0 = (2^21 - 1) * 98,937,639,497 / 2^149, about 2^-91.474. It has three parts: (i) the ordinary first-moment lower of the chunk-counter construction, mu_ordinary >= (2^21 - 1) * 98,937,639,497 / (2^21 * 2^128), five sevenths of the model's conditional count of the six outcomes of S on the class, rounded down; (ii) its transfer at theta0 = 1 to the special chart, mu_raw >= theta0 * mu_ordinary; (iii) equivalently in counts (proof.md A11.1), G * 2^179 >= theta0 * A * T1, with T1 the actual ordinary and G the actual special full valid hits. Given H1 and H2, the cluster bound of A8 (proved, no independence premise) and the budgets of A9 give success above 0.39 at m = 11.
heuristics.scope: Exactly the queries of proof.md A7 on the bases of A5: one fresh 256-bit coin per query, the canonical selected catalog of 13 * 2^27 records with the T31 orientation, the drawn prefix and the 29 free bits of t = S3 + j, the three-hole completion of j, the direct F evaluation and the unique candidate g, each certified by the local tests of A7 (Lemma V); m = 11 queries per base, bases iid, the first N admitted kept. mu_raw counts nonzero-counter selected full valid hits only.
heuristics.extrapolation: Part (i) is the ordinary premise of the chunk-counter search, from the participant's exact model count 67,633,152 * 2^11 for S on the class, taken at five sevenths; it is declared, not proved, there and here. Part (ii) is not implied by the uniformity of the chart: the special chart is a fraction A / 2^179 <= 2^-92 of the ordinary space, and the proved proof-only lower is zero (proof.md A11.1). The exact identity mu_i = Pr_i(H) E_i[n | H] / 2^21 (proof.md A11.1) splits the transfer ratio into a pass-share ratio and a conditional tail ratio. Participant measurements (proof.md A12, untrusted): the filter pass share on special frames is 0.99993 of the ordinary share (b uniform, flags 3), and 0.99938 and 0.99944 of the exact share with b fixed at q = 0 and q = 80000000 (standard error about 0.001); E3 condition (1), filter condition (2) and the pre-check agree between ordinary, special fresh and special j-reuse runs to about 0.1 percent; relaxed-solver roots 5 and 5 in 100,000 passing steps, and 1 and 1 with (G7) and the pre-check. These concern the first factor only.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved. The full valid hit (about 2^-91 per trial) is not observable in any run; the measured events are partial pass events, the solver counts are sparse (mean 5e-5), the pre-check runs used fresh random C/B words rather than the physical ones, the main special run has b over all 32-bit words rather than the two q values, and the j-reuse cluster law is not the catalog query's law (proof.md A12). The ordinary lower in (i) is itself a declared premise. The organizer-run experiments run the root instance and measure none of this.

heuristics.statement: Score-critical. The actual mean frame multiplicity on the priced chart, rbar_C = E over (b in B, z, f, y in C13) of R_frame(b, z, f, y), with B = {q - W13 : q in {0, 80000000}}, flags 3 and C13 the class of eta, is at least r0 = 1. Equivalently the exact number of admitted bases is A = rbar_C * 2^84 >= 2^84, and each proposal of the sampler of proof.md A5 (Lemma S) is admitted with probability rbar_C / 8 >= 1/8. Given H2, Bsam = ceil(2 (N + s)) batches leave fewer than N admitted bases with probability at most exp(-8) (proof.md A9).
heuristics.scope: The b domain of two q values, flags 3, the whole class C13 (524,288 members), z and f all 32-bit words; R_frame counts the roots h of the frame equation AV-FRAME of proof.md A4 (0 <= R_frame <= 64, proved).
heuristics.extrapolation: Proved bounds (proof.md A5): R_frame <= 64, sum over all y of R_frame = 2^32 for fixed (b, z, f), and rbar_C <= 8 (Lemma S). Participant measurements (proof.md A12, untrusted): about 1.7 * 10^13 and 2.66 * 10^13 samples at q = 0 and q = 80000000 give rbar = 1.00000 on C13 and the landing share 2^-13.0000 at both q, at flags 11; the sampler runs of the rate comparison give rbar 1.0000066 and 0.9999983.
heuristics.limitations: Not proved: a full weighted class balance over C13 is open. The large measurement was made at the root flags 11, not the flags 3 of this path; the flags of the rate-comparison sampler runs are not stated with their rbar figures.
